evaluation.hallucination_trigger: Ge'ez (Ethiopic) manuscript with regular scribal hand. Two-column layout with word separators (double colons). Despite clear, well-preserved script, Lite produces 22-33x over-generation. The Ethiopic syllabary's visual regularity may provide strong generation templates.
errors: Fluent fabrication in source script — hard to detect without image comparison
evaluation.notes: Ge'ez showed the highest Lite hallucination rate (20.7% vs 3.0% Flash) in Study 1. The script's regular structure and limited training data may combine to create a strong generation-mode trigger.
